every_required_node_closed_by_an_admissi.rule: each required node must be admissible *and* pass every frozen gate: EXACT_EMPIRICAL_STRONG at L0_EXACT_KEY with both the 20-observation and 20-distinct-hands thresholds met, or EXACT_HIERARCHICAL_ESTIMATE with every frozen layer-B gate passing (NODE_CLOSES_IFF_ALL_FROZEN_LAYER_B_GATES_PASS)

no_hero_ev_or_recommendation_computed.rule: the #367 real ISO EV runner is neither imported nor executed

no_nearest_or_borrowed_substitution_appl.rule: no nearest-price, nearest-context, representative, interpolated or borrowed support

no_pooled_estimate_is_counted_as_exact_s.rule: an exact-context estimate supplies parameters only and is never counted as exact support for the requested key

no_unresolved_raise_sizing_frontier.rule: a RAISE frontier without an exactly supported target keeps the tree open

required_tree_fully_enumerated.rule: the #388 enumeration must be complete, not only its node list

admissibility.rule: required_tree_complete is true only when every required node is closed by an admissible answer and every frozen gate passes; otherwise it is false and carries reason codes. A fail-closed node is reported as EXACT_UNRESOLVED and is never repaired by lowering a frozen threshold

admissibility_protocol.calibration_gate_status: UNEVALUATED_PRE_VALIDATION: this preflight consumes no VALIDATION split, so the frozen absolute/relative calibration gate has no measured evidence and fails closed (REFUSED_CALIBRATION, default_when_a_gate_is_unevaluated=false)
admissibility_protocol.empirical_closure_rule: EXACT_EMPIRICAL_STRONG (layer A, unchanged): pooling.level == L0_EXACT_KEY, both the 20-observation and 20-distinct-hands thresholds met, support.source_key == requested_key and no support borrowed across keys
admissibility_protocol.estimate_closure_rule: EXACT_HIERARCHICAL_ESTIMATE closes the node if and only if every frozen layer-B gate passes (NODE_CLOSES_IFF_ALL_FROZEN_LAYER_B_GATES_PASS); support stays exact-key-only and pooling only feeds the prior

hero_ev_scan.detail: AST scan: the preflight imports neither the #367 real ISO EV runner nor any rollout/EV/adaptive-budget module, and the build re-checks that none appeared in sys.modules while it ran

holdout_access_scan.detail: AST scan: the preflight consumes no VALIDATION/TEST loader, imports no validation/holdout module and opens no hand history

issue367_authorization.consequence: this preflight resolves provider keys only; no #367 real ISO EV run, no exact-support grid extension and no provider wiring is performed

frozen_v1_preflight.reason: the v1 preflight is pinned as an immutable v1 surface by FROZEN_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_V2.json custody and by the T9/T10 terminal decision; this tool re-verifies those bytes and writes only the v2 bundle

key_contract.audit_exact_key_role: strict diagnostic partition only; deliberately finer than both runtime keys so history, pot and stack-bucket merges remain visible; it is not the #367 likelihood lookup key

nearest_substitution_audit.statement: every node is answered by exact string equality on its own requested key; adjacent prices, coarser contexts, representative/interpolated prices, legal-minimum raises and cross-key support borrowings are refused and traced

evidence.reason: this preflight consumes no VALIDATION split, so the frozen absolute/relative calibration gate has no measured evidence and stays open (fail closed)

EFFECTIVE_SAMPLE_SIZE.detail: support.effective_sample_size is credited at the hand level, never inflated by pooling, and the level actually used meets the frozen 20/20 thresholds

EXACT_KEY_IDENTITY.detail: support.source_key == requested_key, no cross-key borrowing and every never-mutualizable axis retained

POOLING_LEVEL.detail: a declared pooling level, EXACT_EMPIRICAL_STRONG only at L0_EXACT_KEY and no reported estimate deeper than L4_POSITION_PRICE_PRIOR

POOLING_PROVENANCE.detail: an exact-context estimate reports the pooling level, its source key, its source counts and the retained/pooled axes, and pools toward a declared parent -- never toward itself

RAISE_SIZING_FRONTIER.detail: raise sizing is exact-support-only: a raise target is emitted only when the exact structural node supports it and no representative, nearest, interpolated, legal-minimum or pruned price fills an unresolved frontier

UNCERTAINTY.detail: the posterior and the uncertainty band are reported, cover every action and reflect the level actually used; an estimate is never shown without its pooling level

posterior_identity.reason_detail: raise sizing for this exact context is an unresolved frontier; no representative, legal-minimum, nearest or interpolated price is permitted

substitution_refusals.detail: the runtime support-context key is parameters-only; a different key may never support this exact key, so the coarser context is recorded and never used
the exact requested price is the only admissible key; an adjacent ISO target is never substituted for it
no representative or averaged raise price may stand in for the exact price
a legal-minimum raise is not an exact supported target and never answers a frontier
no interpolated price between observations may answer the exact key
support counts are exact and are never smoothed or borrowed across levels
